rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / GENERAL FUND APPROPRIATIONS / SUMMARY & CLASSIFICATION OF ACCOUNTS / FISCAL YEAR 2020`, PDF pages 26-30 of the FY2020 annual town report -- the Town Accountant's schedule. READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 1 word on each of the five pages, so there is no text layer; each page is a single JPEG2000 bitmap of about 1060x1400 px (~125 dpi) read at 1.9x in two halves. FIVE MONEY COLUMNS, NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER: APPROPRIATED FORWARD, TOTAL FUNDS AVAILABLE, TOTAL EXPENDED, TOTAL ENCUMBERED, BALANCE TO REVENUE, plus a narrow flag column carrying `fwd`, `srt` or `rft`. 83 DEPARTMENTS, 416 ASSERTIONS, ALL CLOSING TO THE CENT. Per department: the detail lines add to the printed subtotal in each of the four columns they carry, and the subtotal states available - expended - encumbered = balance to revenue (81 of 83 print a balance; the two TRANSFERS TO OTHER FUNDS rows leave it blank, so nothing asserts it there). Across the run: all five columns add down to the printed GRAND TOTAL of $43,104,912.84 / $43,104,912.84 / $41,024,362.43 / $838,486.09 / $1,242,064.32. AND THE PAGE'S OWN FOOTER IS THREE MORE INDEPENDENT IDENTITIES, proved in `fy2020-p26-appropriations-carryforward.csv`: `fwd - forward from FY 2019 $283,034.02`, `srt - Salary Reserve Transfer $17,834.74` and `rft - Reserve Fund Transfer $16,890.00` are the sums of the flag lines scattered through the schedule, and each closes exactly. A `fwd` LINE IS A LINE OF THE COLUMN, not an annotation: every department's printed subtotal includes its flag lines. THIS SETTLES THE RUN. `notes/HANDOFF-ANNUAL-REPORTS.md` recorded the accountant's schedule as the closest FY2020 reconciliation at +$33,741 on $43.1M with nothing tying to the cent; the printed APPROPRIATED FORWARD total is $43,104,912.84 and the 83 departments foot to it exactly. THIS FILE IS THE FOOTER IDENTITIES: every line of the schedule flagged `fwd`, `srt` or `rft`, added down against the three totals the last page prints for them.

rows.proof: `CAPITAL PROJECT FUNDS FY 2020`, PDF page 36 of the FY2020 annual town report. READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 1 word on this page, so there is no text layer; the page is a single JPEG2000 bitmap of 1065x1405 px (~125 dpi), printed LANDSCAPE on a portrait sheet, which was extracted, rotated 90 degrees upright and read at 1.8x in two halves. THREE MONEY COLUMNS, NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER: APPROPRIATED FORWARD, EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/TRANSFERRED, BALANCE, with a narrow flag column that prints `fwd` (the page's own key reads `fwd - forward from FY 19`) on the 25 carried-forward projects and nothing on the 15 voted in FY2020. 40 project rows under a printed Grand Total. SIXTY-THREE ASSERTIONS CLOSE TO THE CENT: the three columns added down against the printed Grand Total of $9,098,079.01 / $2,873,283.70 / $6,224,795.31, and the identity appropriated forward less expended equals balance on each of the 23 rows that print an expended figure. The other 17 rows leave that cell BLANK and their balance equals their appropriation exactly, so nothing is lost by the blank. ONE ROW PRINTS TWO FIGURES IN ONE CELL: `08/02 ATM Development of Cemeteries` carries $35,000.00 on the line ABOVE the row and ($1,148.33) fwd on the row itself; it is recorded as their sum, 33,851.67, and the column total is what establishes that -- 35,000.00 + (1,148.33) - 13,037.41 = 20,814.26, the printed balance, and the column foots to the printed Grand Total only with the 35,000.00 in it. The page was LOOKED AT before that was concluded (rule 3.4); the arithmetic confirmed the assignment rather than choosing it.

rows.proof: `TOWN OF LUNENBURG / TRUST FUNDS / FISCAL YEAR 2020 SUMMARY`, PDF pages 40 (Page 1 of 2) and 41 (Page 2 of 2) of the FY2020 annual town report. READ, NOT RECOGNISED: pdfplumber returns 1 word on each page, so there is no text layer; the page is a single JPEG2000 bitmap of 1113x1444 px (~125 dpi) which was extracted, rotated 90 degrees upright and read at 2x and 3x -- at that size every digit separates. TEN COLUMNS, NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER AND NOT INFERRED (rule 13b.4), left to right: BEGINNING MARKET VALUE, BEGINNING PRINCIPAL, BEGINNING EARNINGS, NET EARNINGS, TRANSFERS OF PRINCIPAL, TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS, ENDING CASH VALUE, CHANGE IN UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS, UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS, ENDING MARKET VALUE; every one is headed `FY 2020`. The two pages carry SIX groups -- CEMETERY (3 funds), CONSERVATION (5), LIBRARY (14), SCHOLARSHIP (13, spanning both pages), MISCELLANEOUS (5) and STABILIZATION (4) -- each with its own printed SUBTOTALS line, under a printed GRAND TOTALS. Each group is read as its own group and footed to its own subtotal; the GRAND TOTALS line is proved separately against the six subtotals in `fy2020-p41-trust-grand-totals.csv`. ACROSS THE TWO PAGES 214 INDEPENDENT ASSERTIONS CLOSE TO THE CENT: 44 funds x 3 row identities, 6 groups x 10 column subtotals, 10 grand-total columns, and the 'held by other banks' table's own 5 columns and 10 row identities. ONE row does not, and it is the DOCUMENT: see the scholarship group. The handoff recorded this year's trust grand total as $7.00 -- that was recognition, and the page prints $3,075,973.52 / $3,408,354.62.
